title: Kth Smallest Element in BST
problem: Given the root of a binary search tree, and an integer k, return the kth smallest value (1-indexed) of all the values of the nodes in the tree.
constraints:
The number of nodes in the tree is n.
1 <= k <= n <= 10^4
edge_cases: k is number of elements in tree
hints: In-order traversal of a BST yields sorted elements. Stop traversal when kth element is reached.
expected_approach: Iterative in-order traversal tracking nodes count.
